interface.name: zsingularity_input_share_manager_v1

description.summary: hand the pointer and keyboard to another device

interface.description: Lets a trusted client place other devices next to the edges of the outputs. When the pointer is pushed through such an edge the compositor hides it, stops delivering pointer and keyboard input to its own surfaces and sends that input to the client instead, until the client gives it back or the person presses the escape keys (Ctrl+Super+Escape).

description.summary: destroy the manager

request.name: get_edge

description.summary: watch a stretch of an output edge

request.description: Watches the given side of the named output, between start and end in layout pixels along that side, measured from the top for left and right and from the left for top and bottom. Only the part of the side that does not touch another output can be crossed.

request.name: get_probe

description.summary: hear pushes against free edges

request.description: Tells the client when the person pushes the pointer firmly against a side of an output that touches neither another output nor an edge, so that a device can be placed there. Nothing is captured.

request.name: get_window

description.summary: drive one window from another device

request.description: Names the toplevel of the given app, and of the given process when pid is not zero, so that the client can show it on another device and send it the input made there. Input sent through the returned object reaches only that window, wherever the pointer of this seat is. When no such window exists the object is closed at once.

request.name: get_drag

description.summary: read the drag in progress

request.description: Describes the drag and drop operation running on this seat when the request arrives, so that its data can be carried to another device. When nothing is being dragged the object only sends done.

description.summary: drag data that comes from another device
the drag in progress on this seat
forget the drag, leaving it running
read the dragged data in one format

request.name: finish

description.summary: end the drag on behalf of another device

request.description: Ends the drag that this object describes. Dropped tells the dragging client that the data was taken elsewhere; cancelled tells it that nothing took it. The button that started the drag is considered released.

description.summary: all formats were sent
a drag of data held by the client
destroy the drag, cancelling it when running

request.name: start

description.summary: start dragging under the pointer

request.description: Starts a drag at the pointer as if its left button had been pressed there. Releasing that button drops the data. When another drag is already running the object is cancelled at once.

description.summary: end the drag without dropping
a surface accepted the drop
the surface that took the drop is done with it
the drag ended without a drop

interface.name: zsingularity_input_share_window_v1

description.summary: one window driven from another device

interface.description: Positions are in the pixels of the image of this window that the ext-image-copy-capture protocol gives for its foreign toplevel handle, so that a point on that image reaches the same point of the window, popups included.

request.name: destroy

description.summary: stop driving the window

request.description: Releases the buttons and keys still held through this object.

request.name: button

description.summary: press or release a button

request.description: Pressing a button also activates the window.

request.name: key

description.summary: press or release a key

request.description: Key is a Linux input event code. Keys are read with the keymap of this seat, and pressing one activates the window.

event.name: identifier

description.summary: the foreign toplevel identifier of the window

event.description: Sent once, before anything else, so that the client can capture this window through its ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1.

event.name: geometry

description.summary: where the window is in its image

event.description: The part of the captured image that is the window itself, without its shadows. Sent after identifier and again whenever it changes.

event.name: closed

description.summary: the window is gone

event.description: Requests made after this event are ignored.

description.summary: pushes against free output edges
stop listening

event.name: pushed

description.summary: the pointer was pushed through a free edge

event.description: Position is where along the side the pointer pushed, measured like the start and end of an edge; length is the length of that side. The next push on any edge is reported only after the pointer has left that edge.

description.summary: a crossable stretch of an output edge

request.name: destroy

description.summary: stop watching this edge

request.description: Ends the capture first when this edge holds it.

request.name: release

description.summary: give the input back

request.description: Ends the capture and puts the pointer just inside this edge, at the given position along it, measured like start and end.

request.name: set_resistance

description.summary: hold the pointer at this edge for a while

request.description: The next crossing happens only after the pointer has been pushed against the edge for this distance, in layout pixels, while the compositor reports the progress with pressing events. The edge becomes free again once crossed. Zero removes the resistance.

event.name: pressing

description.summary: the pointer is pushing against a resisting edge

event.description: Progress goes from 0 to 1; it drops back to 0 when the person stops pushing. Position and fraction are measured like in entered.

event.name: entered

description.summary: the pointer crossed this edge

event.description: The capture started. Position is where the pointer crossed, measured like start and end; fraction is the same place from 0 to 1 within the stretch. Every input event until left goes to this edge.

description.summary: pointer motion, accelerated, in layout pixels
a pointer button, Linux evdev code

event.name: axis

description.summary: scrolling, vertical or horizontal

event.description: Value is in the units of wl_pointer.axis; discrete is the number of wheel clicks, zero for smooth scrolling.

description.summary: a key, Linux evdev code

entry.name: released
entry.summary: the client gave the input back

entry.name: escaped
entry.summary: the person pressed the escape keys

entry.name: cancelled
entry.summary: the compositor took it back, for example to lock the session

event.name: left

description.summary: the capture ended

event.description: Keys and buttons still held on the other device should be released there.

event.name: window_entered

description.summary: a window is being dragged through this edge

event.description: The person is moving a window and pushed the pointer firmly through this edge, as if to throw the window to the device placed there. The move goes on; nothing is captured. App id and pid name the window's app; pid is zero when it is not known. Position and fraction are measured like in entered.

event.name: window_left

description.summary: the dragged window came back or the move ended

event.description: The pointer left this edge while the move went on, or the move was cancelled.

event.name: window_dropped

description.summary: the dragged window was let go through this edge

event.description: The person ended the move while the window was through this edge. The compositor puts the window back where the move started; moving the app to the device is up to the client.
